entreParaVer: Sign in to see this page.
semPermissao: This area is only for people who moderate Alumia.

menores.ajuda: Abuse, exploitation or exposure of minors.

ameaca.ajuda: Someone threatens another person's life or safety.

exposicao.ajuda: Address, phone number, ID, intimate photo or other data that exposes someone.

violencia.ajuda: Calls for or encourages violence against people or groups.

autolesao.ajuda: Someone talks about hurting themselves or ending their life. If it is urgent, call 188 (CVV, Brazil).

odio.ajuda: Attack on a person or group because of race, origin, gender, orientation, religion or disability.

assedio.ajuda: Insistence, humiliation or persecution against someone.

golpe.ajuda: An attempt to trick people into giving money or data.

spam.ajuda: Repeated message, sales or promotion out of place.

outro.ajuda: Something that breaks Alumia's rules and is not listed above.

denunciar.ja: You already reported this. Protocol {protocolo}. We are reviewing it.

denunciar.visitante: No account? Use the site's Report page: public content also enters the queue.

silenciados.ajuda: Muting notifies nobody. On the account it works on every device; on this device only, it stays in this browser.
silenciados.limpar: This list is erased if you use Quick exit.

cuidado.lead: Alumia has written rules, with deadlines and appeals. Here is how it works, no fine print.
cuidado.denunciaTexto: Anyone can report a post, a profile or a community. Whoever reports is never revealed. Each report gets a protocol and you follow it in Notices.
cuidado.filaTexto: Child abuse, threats, exposure of data, incitement to violence and self-harm go to the front of the queue.
cuidado.decisaoTitulo: Every decision has a rule and a reason
cuidado.decisaoTexto: Moderators cite the rule and write the reason. Everything goes into a record that only accepts new lines: nobody deletes or changes what was done.
cuidado.recursoTexto: Whoever was moderated can appeal. The appeal is reviewed by another moderator, never by whoever decided before.
cuidado.lentoTexto: Each place's moderators can ask for an interval between posts or lock a conversation that went off track.
cuidado.silencioTexto: You mute people, conversations, communities and words without notifying anyone. No block is shown to the person muted.
cuidado.desinfoTexto: When a post is about something Fact-checking already verified, it gets a label with the link. The post stays.
cuidado.leiTexto: The Supreme Court decision on article 19 of Brazil's Marco Civil da Internet (Themes 987 and 533) calls for notice, procedure and a reporting channel. This page and the reports page are that channel. Serious illegal content is removed quickly; crimes against honor follow the courts, and moderators may remove content after a notice.
cuidado.niveisTexto: Everyone starts at level 0. A person moves up on their own through account age, participation (support and saves given) and posts without moderation decisions against them. An upheld decision lowers the level. Level 4 is appointed by the coordination.
cuidado.niveisSemLeitura: We count what you do, never what you read: Alumia does not track your reading.
cuidado.semProcedente: days without a decision against you
cuidado.faltamSemProcedente: go {n} days without a moderation decision against you
